name: Irregular verbs: V1, V2, V3
summary: Động từ bất quy tắc không thêm -ed mà có dạng riêng: V1 (nguyên mẫu), V2 (quá khứ), V3 (quá khứ phân từ). V2 dùng cho quá khứ đơn khẳng định (I sent); V3 dùng cho hiện tại hoàn thành (have sent) và câu bị động (was sent). Sau did / didn't / to / will luôn dùng V1. Học theo nhóm quy luật (A–A–A, A–B–B, A–B–C, A–B–A) dễ nhớ hơn học thuộc A–Z.

tables.note: Nhóm lớn nhất: V2 và V3 giống nhau. Học theo vần: -ought/-aught (bought, brought, thought, taught, caught), -d → -t (send/sent, spend, lend, build), -eep → -ept (keep, sleep). get – got – got (tiếng Mỹ hay dùng V3 “gotten”). Dạng có “/”: bản Anh -t, bản Mỹ -ed, cả hai đều đúng.

tables.note: Ba dạng khác nhau, V3 thường có -n/-en (written, taken, given, broken, chosen). Vần i – a – u: begin – began – begun, drink, ring, sing, swim. Vần -ew – -own: grow – grew – grown, know, fly, throw. Nhóm hay nhầm nhất: “has wrote”, “was broke”.

tables.title: V3 = V1 (A–B–A) and other patterns

rows.label: beat
cells: We have beaten our sales target.

rows.label: become
cells: She has become our team lead.

rows.label: come
cells: The new interns came on Monday.

rows.label: overcome
cells: We have overcome the main technical issues.

rows.label: prove
cells: The new tool has proven very useful.

rows.label: run
cells: I ran the tests again, and they passed.

tables.note: V3 giống V1, chỉ V2 khác: come – came – come, become, overcome, run – ran – run. Nhóm này quá nhỏ nên gộp thêm mẫu khác: beat – beat – beaten (V2 = V1) và prove – proved – proven (V3 thêm -n).

uses.title: V2 – quá khứ đơn khẳng định
uses.explain: Dùng V2 cho việc đã xảy ra và kết thúc trong quá khứ (yesterday, last week, in 2020). Chỉ dùng V2 trong câu khẳng định; câu hỏi và phủ định dùng did / didn't + V1.

examples.en: I sent the proposal to the client yesterday.
examples.vi: Hôm qua tôi đã gửi bản đề xuất cho khách hàng.

examples.en: We met the new team in Singapore last month.
examples.vi: Tháng trước chúng tôi gặp đội mới ở Singapore.

uses.title: V3 – sau have / has / had (thì hoàn thành)
uses.explain: Have / has / had + V3 tạo thì hoàn thành: việc đã xong nhưng còn liên quan đến hiện tại, hoặc kinh nghiệm (ever, yet, already, since).

examples.en: I have written the test cases.
examples.vi: Tôi đã viết xong các test case.

examples.en: Has the client paid the invoice yet?
examples.vi: Khách hàng đã thanh toán hóa đơn chưa?

examples.en: She has never forgotten a deadline.
examples.vi: Cô ấy chưa bao giờ quên hạn chót.

uses.title: V3 – sau be (câu bị động)
uses.explain: Be (am / is / are / was / were / been / be) + V3 tạo câu bị động, nhấn mạnh việc được làm, không phải ai làm.

examples.en: The bug was found during testing.
examples.vi: Lỗi được phát hiện trong lúc kiểm thử.

examples.en: All files are kept on the shared drive.
examples.vi: Tất cả tệp được lưu trên ổ chung.

examples.en: The report will be sent on Friday.
examples.vi: Báo cáo sẽ được gửi vào thứ Sáu.

uses.title: V1 – sau did / didn't / to / will / can
uses.explain: Khi đã có did, to hoặc động từ khuyết thiếu (will, can, should), động từ chính luôn ở dạng nguyên mẫu V1, kể cả khi nói về quá khứ.

examples.en: Did you send the file? – No, I didn't send it.
examples.vi: Bạn đã gửi tệp chưa? – Chưa, tôi chưa gửi.

examples.en: I forgot to bring my laptop charger.
We will meet the vendor tomorrow.
examples.vi: Ngày mai chúng tôi sẽ gặp nhà cung cấp.

mistakes.explain: Send là động từ bất quy tắc: send – sent – sent. Không thêm -ed.

mistakes.wrong: Did you went to the meeting?
mistakes.right: Did you go to the meeting?
mistakes.explain: Did đã chỉ quá khứ, nên động từ chính dùng V1: go.

mistakes.wrong: I have went to the bank. / She has wrote the email.
mistakes.right: I have gone to the bank. / She has written the email.
mistakes.explain: Sau have / has dùng V3, không dùng V2: go – went – gone, write – wrote – written.

mistakes.wrong: I have saw this error before.
mistakes.right: I have seen this error before.
mistakes.explain: see – saw – seen; saw là V2, sau have phải là V3 seen.
Sau be dùng V3: break – broke – broken.

mistakes.wrong: He has drank too much coffee.
mistakes.right: He has drunk too much coffee.
mistakes.explain: drink – drank – drunk; sau has dùng V3 drunk.

mistakes.wrong: I thinked the deadline was Friday.
mistakes.right: I thought the deadline was Friday.
mistakes.explain: think – thought – thought. Các động từ -ought/-aught: buy, bring, think, teach, catch, fight, seek.
pay – paid – paid, say – said – said, lay – laid – laid: viết -aid, không viết -ayed.

drills.prompt: I ___ (send) the file to the client yesterday.
drills.explain: send – sent – sent; “yesterday” → quá khứ đơn dùng V2.

drills.prompt: We ___ (meet) the new CTO at the town hall last Friday.
drills.explain: meet – met – met; “last Friday” → V2.

drills.prompt: She ___ (buy) a new laptop for the design team last week.
drills.explain: buy – bought – bought; “last week” → V2.

drills.prompt: The meeting ___ (begin) at 9 a.m. sharp this morning.
drills.explain: begin – began – begun; việc đã xong sáng nay → V2 “began”.

drills.prompt: Have you ___ (write) the weekly report yet?
drills.explain: write – wrote – written; sau “have” → V3.

drills.prompt: Our new office was ___ (build) in 2020.
drills.explain: build – built – built; bị động “was” + V3.

drills.prompt: Did you ___ (take) notes at the meeting?
drills.explain: take – took – taken; sau “did” dùng nguyên mẫu V1.

drills.prompt: Our team ___ (win) the hackathon last month.
drills.explain: win – won – won; “last month” → V2.

drills.prompt: Nam has ___ (lead) the mobile team since January.
drills.explain: lead – led – led; có “has” → V3.

drills.prompt: The price of cloud storage ___ (rise) by 10% last quarter.
drills.explain: rise – rose – risen; “last quarter” → V2.

drills.prompt: Thousands of customer passwords were ___ (steal) in the data breach.
drills.explain: steal – stole – stolen; bị động “were” + V3.

drills.prompt: I've ___ (forget) my access card at home again.
drills.explain: forget – forgot – forgotten; “I've” = I have → V3.

drills.prompt: I ___ (learn) a lot from the senior developers on my first project.
drills.explain: learn – learnt / learned; việc đã qua → V2, cả hai dạng đều đúng.

drills.prompt: We didn't ___ (spend) the whole marketing budget.
drills.explain: spend – spent – spent; sau “didn't” dùng V1.

drills.prompt: The client has ___ (choose) the second design option.
drills.explain: choose – chose – chosen; có “has” → V3.

drills.prompt: He ___ (quit) his job in June and joined a startup.
drills.explain: quit – quit – quit; ba dạng giống nhau, “in June” → V2.

drills.prompt: The server room door must be ___ (shut) at all times.
drills.explain: shut – shut – shut; bị động “be” + V3, V3 vẫn là “shut”.

drills.prompt: Sales have ___ (fall) sharply since the new competitor entered the market.
drills.explain: fall – fell – fallen; có “have” → V3.

drills.prompt: The CEO ___ (lay) out the new strategy at the kickoff meeting.
drills.explain: lay – laid – laid; việc đã xảy ra → V2 “laid” (không viết “layed”).

drills.prompt: The keynote will be ___ (broadcast) live on our YouTube channel.
drills.explain: broadcast – broadcast – broadcast; bị động “be” + V3, không thêm -ed.

drills.prompt: Prices have ___ (become) more stable since March.
drills.explain: become – became – become; có “have” → V3 giống V1.

drills.prompt: Our app ___ (freeze) twice during the live demo yesterday.
drills.explain: freeze – froze – frozen; “yesterday” → V2.

drills.prompt: By the time the workshop started, we had ___ (run) out of ideas.
drills.explain: run – ran – run; sau “had” → V3, giống V1.

drills.prompt: Yesterday I ___ an email to HR about my annual leave.
drills.explain: send – sent – sent; “yesterday” → V2. Không có “sended”.

drills.prompt: Did you ___ the client at the airport yesterday?
drills.explain: Sau “did” dùng V1: meet (meet – met – met).

drills.prompt: I have ___ this bug before.
drills.explain: see – saw – seen; có “have” → V3.

drills.prompt: The office window was ___ during the storm last night.
drills.explain: break – broke – broken; bị động “was” + V3.

drills.prompt: She ___ to Da Nang for a client workshop last week.
drills.explain: go – went – gone; “last week” → V2.

drills.prompt: I'll ___ you the slides after lunch.
drills.explain: give – gave – given; sau “will” dùng V1.

drills.prompt: We ___ a lot of coffee during the release night.
drills.explain: drink – drank – drunk; câu khẳng định quá khứ → V2.

drills.prompt: Has the courier ___ the package yet?
drills.explain: bring – brought – brought; sau “has” → V3. Không có “brang”.

drills.prompt: He has ___ three blog posts about Kubernetes this month.
drills.explain: write – wrote – written; có “has” → V3.

drills.prompt: I ___ the instructions twice, but I still couldn't install the driver.
drills.explain: read – read – read (V2 đọc /red/). Không có “readed”.

drills.prompt: The opening speech was ___ by the CEO herself.
drills.explain: give – gave – given; bị động “was” + V3.

drills.prompt: The manager didn't ___ why the project was cancelled.
drills.explain: Sau “didn't” dùng V1: say (say – said – said).

drills.prompt: Have you ever ___ business class?
drills.explain: fly – flew – flown; “have … ever” → V3.

drills.prompt: Our online sales ___ by 15% after the new campaign.
drills.explain: grow – grew – grown; việc đã qua → V2.

drills.prompt: Have you ___ the CFO about the budget cut?
drills.explain: tell – told – told; sau “have” → V3.

drills.prompt: These photos were ___ at the year-end party.
drills.explain: take – took – taken; bị động “were” + V3.

drills.prompt: The team has ___ the sales target three quarters in a row.
drills.explain: beat – beat – beaten; có “has” → V3 “beaten”.

drills.prompt: The workload was ___ evenly across the three teams.
drills.explain: spread – spread – spread; bị động “was” + V3, không thêm -ed.

drills.prompt: Since joining the company, she has ___ a key member of the team.
drills.explain: become – became – become; sau “has” → V3 giống V1.

drills.prompt: The phone ___ three times before anyone answered.
drills.explain: ring – rang – rung; quá khứ đơn → V2 “rang”.

drills.prompt: Has the finance team ___ the vendor yet?
drills.explain: pay – paid – paid; sau “has” → V3. Không viết “payed”.

drills.prompt: The new feature has been ___ in the latest app update.
drills.explain: hide – hid – hidden; bị động “has been” + V3.

drills.prompt: Before the merger, the company had ___ two smaller startups.
drills.explain: buy – bought – bought; sau “had” → V3. Đừng nhầm với brought (bring).

drills.prompt: I sended the invoice to the client this morning.
drills.explain: send – sent – sent; không thêm -ed.

drills.prompt: Did you went to the training session yesterday?
drills.explain: Sau “did” dùng V1: go – went – gone.

drills.prompt: She has wrote the user manual for the new app.
drills.explain: write – wrote – written; có “has” → V3.

drills.prompt: I have saw this error message before.
drills.explain: see – saw – seen; có “have” → V3.

drills.prompt: The printer was broke, so I used the one on the third floor.
drills.explain: break – broke – broken; sau “was” → V3.

drills.prompt: He has drank three cups of coffee since the meeting started.
drills.explain: drink – drank – drunk; có “has” → V3.

drills.prompt: I thinked the deadline was Friday.
drills.explain: think – thought – thought; không thêm -ed.

drills.prompt: We have went over budget twice this year.
drills.explain: go – went – gone; có “have” → V3.
